summary: Draw (not refuse): in the editor's default mode (headless engine without readOnly, and the live editor), an accepted typed block whose content breaks its ProseMirror content rule is drawn as its literal lines, as INFRA-529's read-only mode does, instead of Milkdown dropping it silently. Unknown types, refused attributes and paragraph-line directives still throw. INFRA-529's fit check, drawDirective and the innermost-first walk move into a new legion-owned packages/proof-editor/src/typed-block-drawing.ts with markdownSource(file) (one leading U+FEFF removed); remarkTypedBlocks reads its source through it; lib-headless default branch installs remarkUnfitTypedBlocks; lib.ts installs unfitTypedBlocksRemarkPlugin AFTER remarkDispatchMarksPlugin.
